# implicates

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:implicates`](gmeow-implicates.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/implicates>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a deceptive event to a proposition or entity that it conversationally or contextually implicates — the paltering mechanism, where a literally true statement misleadingly implies a false conclusion. No reasoner semantics: implicature is a solver-layer computation ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)), not an OWL entailment.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:implicates`](gmeow-implicates.md) from [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md), [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the false conclusion a literally-true projected claim misleadingly implies — the paltering hook ([`gmeow:eventTypePaltering`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypePaltering.md)), where the gap is between literal content and pragmatic implicature, not between literal claim and held belief.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the literal projected claim itself (that is [`gmeow:projectedStandpoint`](gmeow-projectedStandpoint.md)) and avoid expecting the reasoner to derive the implicature — it carries no OWL entailment; the implicature computation stays in the solver layer ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### How to use

- On a paltering event, set the technically-true [`gmeow:projectedStandpoint`](gmeow-projectedStandpoint.md) and link the misleading conclusion via [`gmeow:implicates`](gmeow-implicates.md); let a solver score the implicature against the held standpoint rather than asserting it logically.

### Examples

- ex:palter [`gmeow:implicates`](gmeow-implicates.md) ex:falseConclusion.
